messages:
tara: Heads-up: scheduling a micro-window at 02:00 UTC to pin runtime v2.4.3 and api v1.8.2. Console change is a feature-flag flip only. We need a fast router handshake sanity for the batching-header permutation before we freeze. @marco @router-eng please run a quick staging smoke. deploy-bot will do a dry-run.

deploy-bot: dry-run queued in 12m. Will enforce pin freeze 7m before window. /deploy status: no infra migrations detected.

marco: Quick staging pass done. Under burst load runtime switches to a compact batching kernel and we saw short-lived 502 spikes. Sample log: ```
2026-03-23T01:34:02Z WARN router.proxy: upstream 502 - header-perm mismatch; expected [meta,flags,seq], got [flags,meta,seq]
stack: router.proxy -> runtime.frontend -> runtime.kv
```
Looks like header permutation at kernel layer.

router-eng: Parser in prod is strict. I can ship a temporary tolerant parser (`router.accept_swapped_headers=true`) as a shim and canary to a small subset of nodes. No external schema change.

tara: Rollback plan (short): if 5xx >0.3% sustained for 6m -> rollback runtime to v2.4.2 immediately. If errors persist after runtime rollback, flip router tolerant parser and reassess. If client-visible errors continue, roll api back to v1.8.1. Order: runtime -> router shim -> api. Also if p99 latency for user-facing requests >350ms for 2m, treat as immediate rollback trigger. @sre-oncall can you own the alerting and paging?

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll create two alert rules: (1) 5xx >0.3% for 6m -> notify #incidents + page PD, (2) p99 >350ms for 2m -> page immediately. I'll add a short runbook that lists the exact rollback commands and the pin-unpin steps.

console-eng: We'll add a transient banner during the micro-window and append `router.accept_swapped_headers=true` to release notes if we enable the shim. Also adding a console telemetry probe that calls a lightweight header-order check every 20s.

router-eng: Starting canary of the tolerant parser on r-canary-4 (1/1). Watching 5xx and p99; will report in ~6m.

deploy-bot: dry-run complete. Canary started (1/1). Full rollout estimated 12-18m after green.

marco: Canary shows brief p95 uptick (~40ms) on KV hot keys but 5xx stable. No client-visible errors. If p99 >360ms or 5xx >0.3% for 3m during canary, we'll abort.

tara: Locking pin window 02:00-02:20 UTC. Draft release notes: "runtime v2.4.3 - compact batching kernel; api v1.8.2 - tolerant header parsing; router - optional `router.accept_swapped_headers=true` shim (auto-revert 30m)." Will notify SE/support in the release notes.

router-eng: Shim set to auto-revert 30m after rollout. Tagging rollout metadata `#accept-swapped-headers`.

sre-oncall: Pager on standby. I'll escalate per alert rules.

marco: Canary green for 10m. No threshold breaches. Ready to proceed to roll.

tara: Proceeding with pin at 02:00 UTC. If any signal trips, follow rollback order and post status here. Thanks all.
